import os,glob,re,json

        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]

            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G

steps.input:
# New hypothesis: each object (as rigid body) slides ONE STEP at a time toward the nearest other object,
# choosing the direction that maximally reduces the Chebyshev distance between their bounding boxes / closest cells,
# until no further move reduces distance (touching). Simulate and test.

from collections import Counter
def comps_no_noise(g):
    cnt=Counter(x for row in g for x in row)
    bgi=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    noise=min((v for v in cnt if v!=bgi),key=lambda x:cnt[x])
    seen=set(); res=[]
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if g[r][c]!=bgi and g[r][c]!=noise and (r,c) not in seen:
                q=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cur=[]
                while q:
                    y,x=q.pop(); cur.append((y,x,g[y][x]))
                    for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                        if 0<=ny<H and 0<=nx<W and g[ny][nx]!=bgi and g[ny][nx]!=noise and (ny,nx) not in seen:
                            seen.add((ny,nx)); q.append((ny,nx))
                res.append(sorted(cur))
    return res,bgi,noise

def mindist(a,b):
    # min Chebyshev distance between cells of the two shapes (excluding overlap)
    return min(max(abs(y-y2),abs(x-x2)) for y,x,_ in a for y2,x2,_ in b)

def sim(I,O=None,verbose=False):
    I2,bgi,noise=comps_no_noise.__name__ and None,None,None
    I2,bgi,noise=process(I)
    ci=comps(I2,bgi)
    n=len(ci)
    # order by size descending (largest first)
    order=sorted(range(n),key=lambda i:-len(ci[i]))
    pos=[[(r,c,v) for r,c,v in ci[i]] for i in range(n)]
    maxsteps=400
    for t in range(maxsteps):
        moved=False
        for idx in order:
            p=pos[idx]; base=mindist(p,[q for j,q in enumerate(pos) if j!=idx])[0] if False else None
            best_dir=None
            best_score=-1e9
            cands=[(-1,0),(1,0),(0,-1),(0,1)]
            # direction candidates: toward centroid of others
            others=[q[0] for q in pos if q is not p][:0]
            sy=sum(q[0] for q in pos if q is not p)/max(len(pos)-1,1)
            sx=sum(q[1] for q in pos if q is not p)/max(len(pos)-1,1)
            sy=p[0][0]-sy; sx=p[0][1]-sx
            dirs=[(int(sy>0)-int(sy<0),int(sx>0)-int(sx<0))]
            dirs=[d for d in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)) if d==dirs[0] or abs(d[0]+dirs[0][0])+abs(d[1]+dirs[0][1])==1]
            for dy,dx in dirs:
                np_=[(r+dy,c+dx,v) for r,c,v in p]
                ok=True
                for r,c,v in np_:
                    rr,cc=r+dy,c+dx
                    if not(0<=rr<len(I2) and 0<=cc<len(I2[0])): ok=False;break
                    if I2[rr][cc] not in (bgi,v): ok=False;break
                sc=-mindist(np_,[q for j,q in enumerate(pos) if j!=idx])
                if sc>best_score: best_score=sc; best_dir=(dy,dx)
            if best_dir and best_dir==(0,0):
                # try diagonal
                for dy,dx in ((1,1),(1,-1),(-1,1),(-1,-1)):
                    np_=[(r+dy,c+dx,v) for r,c,v in p]
                    ok=True
                    for r,c,v in np_:
                        rr,cc=r+dy,c+dx
                        if not(0<=rr<len(I2) and 0<=cc<len(I2[0])): ok=False;break
                        if I2[rr][cc] not in (bgi,v): ok=False;break
                    sc=-mindist(np_,[q for j,q in enumerate(pos) if j!=idx])
                    if sc>best_score: best_score=sc; best_dir=(dy,dx)
            if best_dir!=(0,0):
                for r,c,v in pos[idx]:
                    I2[r][c]=bgi
                    I2[r+(best_dir[0]),c+(best_dir[1])]=v
                pos[idx]=[ (r+best_dir[0],c+best_dir[1],v) for r,c,v in p ]
                moved=True
        if not moved: break
    # crop to content
    mr=max(r for r in range(len(I2)) for c in range(len(I2[0])) if I2[r][c]!=bgi)+1
    mc=max(c for r in range(len(I2)) for c in range(len(I2[0])) if I2[r][c]!=bgi)+1
    return [row[:mc] for row in I2[:mr]],pos,O

for n in [1,5,6]:
    I=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; O=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    P,_ ,_=sim(I,O)
    print('pair',n,'match:',P==O, len(P),len(P[0]),len(O),len(O[0]))
